ns2:section.sectionText: Video lectures, course materials, and a discussion board will be made available online through Compass2g (compass2g.illinois.edu). Discussion section meets via Blackboard Collaborate webconference MWF at noon. Attendance in discussion is encouraged but not required, and recordings of discussion sections will be available for review afterwards. Students are expected to take course exams either on campus or at an approved off-site testing center and to complete online assignments on MasteringChemistry as outlined in the syllabus. Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://online.illinois.edu.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $402.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $359.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
